content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight","priority":30,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"fight-back"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"neq","value":11}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-ladder"}},{"id":"navigate-y","priority":9,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.y","op":"neq","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-ladder"}}]},"skills":[{"name":"fight-back","skill":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); const me = await b.body(); const m = ms.filter(m => Math.abs(m.x-me.x)+Math.abs(m.y-me.y) <= 1)[0]; if (!m) return; await b.selectSlot(0); await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX'); await b.wait(150); }","check":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); const me = await b.body(); const near = ms.some(m => Math.abs(m.x-me.x)+Math.abs(m.y-me.y) <= 1); return {ok: !near, detail: 'monsters near: '+near}; }"},{"name":"go-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const me = await b.body(); const tx = 11, ty = 1; const dx = tx - me.x, dy = ty - me.y; const presses = []; if (dx > 0) presses.push({press:['DPadRight'], ms: Math.min(600, dx*120)}); else if (dx < 0) presses.push({press:['DPadLeft'], ms: Math.min(600, -dx*120)}); if (dy < 0) presses.push({press:['DPadUp'], ms: Math.min(600, -dy*120)}); else if (dy > 0) presses.push({press:['DPadDown'], ms: Math.min(600, dy*120)}); if (presses.length) await b.press(presses); await b.wait(100); }","check":"async (b) => { const me = await b.body(); return {ok: me.x === 11 && me.y === 1, detail: 'at '+me.x+','+me.y}; }"}]}
